text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san! How did you like the present? I 
left it in front of your room!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just thinking of thanking you! 
So that big flower stand was from you, 
Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know how people send flower 
stands to actors at theater plays? So I 
thought it'd be totally perfect!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I see. What an ingenious idea, as 
expected of you! Still, I was surprised by 
how brightly it shone. Did you put 
illumination lights inside?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
After all, Fuji-san is what they call a 
once-in-a-generation entertainer-ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Instead of some ordinary flower, a 
blindingly brilliant one suits you way 
better, right?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, honestly I wanted to light it up 
with spotlights like a real stage, but I 
couldn't haul them in...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! No, you surprised me plenty. It's 
nice being on the receiving end of a 
surprise once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm glad you liked it! Ah, don't 
worry about the flower stand, I'll clean 
it up later, so no need to fret!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I hope a whole crowd comes! Pokke 
gave me such a nice present, after all, so 
I want everyone to see it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To thank Pokke, I'll prepare an 
extra-special return gift for her♪ Hehehe!
